---
title: "California County Population and Median Age"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "CA",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca_wide <- age_ca |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(GEOID, NAME),
    names_from = variable,
    values_from = estimate
  )

plot_exercise5 <- age_ca_wide |>
  ggplot(aes(x = median_age, y = population)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(
    data = age_ca_wide |>
      slice_max(population, n = 5) |>
      arrange(median_age),
    aes(label = stringr::str_remove(NAME, " County, California")),
    hjust = 1.1,
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "California County Population by Median Age",
    x = "Median age (years)",
    y = "County population (log scale)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2016–2020 American Community Survey"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

plot_exercise5
```
